A row not named here is a defect; the families KX, SS, PG, SR, IM are directions by prefix. Each entry: kind, was (its kind before), pri (its priority when reclassified, which the register must still show), why. blockedBy: the architecture row a row waits on; a blocked defect is still a defect.
